FN-QGQF115-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 88
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/19/2024
Senate Bill 88 as introduced would increase the membership of the Alabama Firefighters'
Personnel Standards and Education Commission by one member, which would increase the
financial obligations of the Commission by an estimated average of $202 per meeting attended
by the additional member.
